record.field: Create a sales invoice
accounting
invoice, bill a customer, credit sale, on account

For a sale the customer pays later:

  1. Open Accounting → Customers & Sales → Sales Invoices (on account), or Sales → Invoicing.
  2. Click New, choose the customer and the date. The due date follows the customer's payment terms.
  3. Add the lines: item, quantity, price. VAT is added from the item's tax.
  4. Post it. The invoice number is given at posting.
  5. In Ethiopia the customer's invoice itself is issued from your fiscal cash register or as the Ministry of Revenue's QR-coded e-invoice: Unio records the sale but does not print invoices. Elsewhere, Print gives the PDF in your company's design.

Paid on the spot? Use Cash Sales instead: it records the sale and the money in one step.
Record money received from a customer
accounting
receipt, CRV, customer payment, collect, paid invoice

1. Open Accounting → Customers & Sales → Receipts (CRV) and click New.
  2. Choose the customer: their open invoices appear.
  3. Enter the amount and where the money went (cash, bank, cheque, telebirr).
  4. Tick the invoices it pays. Part payments are fine.
  5. Post. The invoices show as paid, and the customer's balance goes down.

Withholding deducted by the customer? Enter it on the receipt with the certificate number; it goes to your withholding receivable.
Record a supplier bill and pay it
accounting
vendor bill, purchase invoice, CPV, pay supplier, payable

1. Accounting → Vendors & Purchases → Purchase Bills (on account) → New: supplier, date, lines, Post.
  2. To pay: Payments (CPV) → New, choose the supplier, tick the bills, choose the bank or cash account, Post.
  3. Several bills at once: Pay Several Bills.
VAT report and VAT return
accounting
vat, tax report, ministry of revenue, monthly tax, output tax, input tax

Open Accounting → Reports → Report Center and choose the VAT report for the month. It lists output VAT on sales and input VAT on purchases, and the amount to pay or carry forward.

Export it to Excel or PDF from the report screen. Withholding and payroll tax reports are in the same Report Center.
Financial statements
accounting
profit and loss, income statement, balance sheet, statement of financial position, trial balance

Accounting → Reports → Report Center has the Statement of Financial Position, the Income Statement (profit and loss), the Trial Balance, cash flow, and ledgers. Choose the period (Ethiopian or Gregorian months), compare with last year, drill into any figure, and export to PDF or Excel.

Report Packs put several reports together, for the bank or the board.
Reconcile the bank
accounting
bank reconciliation, bank statement, match, reconcile accounts

1. Accounting → Banking → Reconcile Accounts, choose the bank account and the statement date.
  2. Enter the statement's closing balance, or import the statement file.
  3. Tick what cleared the bank; add bank charges and interest from the same screen.
  4. When the difference is zero, finish the reconciliation. It is kept and can be printed.
Opening balances when you start
accounting
beginning balance, migrate, peachtree, start using, trial balance

Start from your last trial balance: Accounting → General Ledger → Beginning Balances. Enter one balanced opening trial balance, then the open customer invoices and supplier bills (so ageing and statements are right), and the stock on hand under Inventory → Stock → Opening Stock.

Moving from Peachtree? Ask us: we import the chart, customers, suppliers, items and balances for you.
Run payroll
payroll
salary, payslip, pay employees, pension, income tax

1. Accounting → Payroll → Payroll Runs → New, choose the month.
  2. The employees, their pay, overtime, allowances, income tax and pension are calculated by your country's rules.
  3. Check it, then Post: the payroll entry is made.
  4. Pay it: choose the bank and the date; print the bank letter or transfer list and the payslips.

Employees see their own payslips under People → My Payslips.
Add an employee
people
new employee, hire, staff, contract, hr
People → Directory → New: name, position, department, start date, salary, bank account, TIN and pension number. Leave, attendance and payroll use it from then on.
Add a user and choose what they can do
settings
new user, invite, access rights, permission, role, login

1. Settings → Users & Companies → Users → New.
  2. Name and email (their login). They receive an email to choose a password.
  3. Choose the role in each app (for example, Accounting: accountant or user only).

Users who only see their own payslips and leave are free.
Create a quotation and a sales order
sales
quotation, quote, proforma, sales order, order

1. Sales → Orders → Quotations → New: customer, items, prices.
  2. Print or send it. When the customer agrees, Confirm: it becomes a sales order.
  3. From the order, deliver (delivery order) and invoice, all at once or in parts.
Receive goods from a supplier
inventory
grn, goods received, receive stock, purchase order delivery

Inventory → Receive → Goods Received (GRN) → New, or open the purchase order and receive it. Enter the quantities that arrived and Post: stock goes up and the cost is recorded. The bill can then be matched to it.
Issue stock and count stock
inventory
giv, goods issued, stock count, physical count, adjustment, bin card

Goods Issued (GIV) takes stock out for use or production. For a count: Inventory → Reports → Physical Count Sheet to print, then Stock → Stock Counts and Adjustments to enter what you counted; the differences are posted with a reason.

Every item's movements are on its Stock Card (Bin Card).
Design your invoices and documents
accounting
print, invoice design, template, logo, pdf, receipt printer, amharic

Accounting → Documents and Printing: pick a document (receipt, payment voucher, delivery note, quotation…; in Ethiopia sales invoices are not printed: they come from the fiscal cash register or the Ministry's e-invoice), then a design (Classic, Modern, Compact, Bold), paper (A4, A5, 80 mm receipt), colours, font and language (English, Amharic or both). Show or hide parts: logo, TIN, amount in words, bank accounts, signatures, stamp. The preview changes as you go; Save for that document or Use for every document.

Your logo: Settings → General Settings → Companies.
Switch apps on or off
settings
apps, inventory missing, production, show app, hide app, modules
Every app is included in your subscription. Open Apps in the left bar and switch on what your business uses (for example Inventory or Fleet). Switching one off only hides it; nothing is deleted.
Build your own app with Studio
studio
studio, custom app, custom field, form, automation, no code

Open Studio (administrators). Describe a process in a sentence and get a draft app, start from a template, or change an existing screen: add fields, move them, hide or rename them. Automations remind people, fill fields, post notes or send emails when something happens. Every change is kept: go back to any earlier version from the history.
Subscribe and pay
billing
subscribe, payment, trial ends, telebirr, chapa, cbe, price, invoice

Click the Trial badge at the top, or open unio.et/subscribe from your system. Choose the number of users and send the request; then pay with telebirr (scan the QR or type the transaction number), Chapa (CBE Birr, telebirr, M-Pesa, cards) or bank transfer. Your system keeps everything from the trial.

Price: 999 birr per user a month, 5% less per user for every extra user (up to 30%).
Refer a business and earn free months
billing
referral, refer, invite, discount, free month
Click the gift icon at the top. Share your link: the business you invite gets 20% off its first 3 months, and you get a free month when it starts paying. There is no limit.
What happens when the trial ends
billing
trial expired, read only, locked, cannot edit
Nothing is deleted. Without a subscription the system becomes read-only: you can still open and print everything, but not change it. Subscribe and it opens again at once.
Ethiopian calendar and fiscal year
accounting
ethiopian date, calendar, fiscal year, meskerem, hamle, period

Ethiopian companies work in Ethiopian months by default: reports, periods and printed documents show Ethiopian dates (the Gregorian date is kept alongside). The fiscal year follows your setting (for example Hamle to Sene). Year-end closing is done from the accounting periods.
Your website and online shop
website
website, online shop, ecommerce, e-commerce, store, web orders, sell online

Open Website. Your site lives at your company's address (for example yourcompany.unio.et).

  1. Products: switch on the products to sell online; pictures, prices and stock come from the product itself. The star puts it on the home page.
  2. Pages: each page is made of blocks (banner, products, why us, customer quotes, questions, contact). Change words and pictures; the preview updates as you type. Publish makes it public.
  3. Look: style, colours, font, logo.
  4. Shop and contact: pickup and delivery fee, pay on delivery, bank transfer or telebirr, and where new orders are emailed.
  5. On the Overview, Put it online.

Web orders arrive in Sales as quotations (or confirmed at once, if you choose), with the customer's phone and address.
